about: A 3/4 pickup: measure lengths, the pickup note on the third beat, and no measure-length warning (G01 §6.3, §6.4, A16).
spec: G01 §6.3: an implicit measure with content lasts its content; the first short measure and a last measure that add up to the time signature need no warning. §6.4: a short first measure is counted back from its bar line, so its one quarter is beat 3 (index 2).
